name: find_label_row
description: The one row of the label table for a label and a labeling section, and the CFR clauses that row can be read under. Returns the row; it does not decide the answer.

label.description: The label, by the established name as the table keys it. Not the product as written in the question.

section.description: The labeling section the question is about, as the table keys it: bw for the boxed warning, else the section number (5, 5.1, 6, 8.1). A question about a reportable adverse event is read against section 6.

found.description: false when the table has no row for this label and section. There is then no row to answer from.

row.description: The row, exactly as the table holds it (pharmadelta milestones/M00/fields.md). null when found is false.

clause_candidates.description: The clause ids of data/clauses.json this row can be read under: the row's requirement first, then the clauses its section is read with. Which one the question turns on is the agent's to say; the tool does not decide it.

source.description: Where the row was read. The deployed runtime reads the DynamoDB table the platform loads from data/table.json; a run outside the runtime reads the file.
